data.name: Privacy_Section1_Overview
data.value: The following notes provide a simple overview of what happens to your personal data when you visit this website. Personal data are all data with which you can be personally identified. Detailed information on data protection can be found in our privacy policy below.

data.name: Privacy_Section1_DataCollectionResponsibilityTitle
data.value: Who is responsible for data collection on this website?

data.name: Privacy_Section1_DataCollectionResponsibilityText
data.value: Data processing on this website is carried out by the website operator. Their contact details can be found in the imprint of this website.

data.name: Privacy_Section1_HowCollectTitle
data.value: How do we collect your data?

data.name: Privacy_Section1_HowCollectText
data.value: Your data is collected, for example, when you provide it to us (e.g. contact form). Other data is automatically captured by our IT systems when you visit the website, especially technical data such as browser, OS or visit time.

data.name: Privacy_Section1_WhyUseTitle
data.value: What do we use your data for?

data.name: Privacy_Section1_WhyUseText
data.value: Part of the data is collected to provide a fault-free website. Other data may be used to analyze user behavior.

data.name: Privacy_Section1_RightsText
data.value: You have the right to obtain information about the origin, recipient and purpose of your stored personal data at any time, and the right to correction or deletion. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory authority.

data.name: Privacy_Section2_Content1
data.value: This website is hosted by an external provider. Personal data is stored on the provider's servers, e.g. IP addresses, contact requests, meta and communication data.

data.name: Privacy_Section2_Content2
data.value: The use of the hoster is for contract performance (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. b GDPR) and in the interest of a secure and efficient online offer (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR).

data.name: Privacy_Section2_Content3
data.value: Our hoster processes personal data only as required for its duties and according to our instructions.

data.name: Privacy_Section3_Text1
data.value: The website operators take the protection of your personal data very seriously. We treat your personal data confidentially and in accordance with legal data protection regulations.

data.name: Privacy_Section3_Text2
data.value: When you use this website, various personal data are collected. This privacy policy explains what data we collect and for what purpose.

data.name: Privacy_Section3_Text3
data.value: Note: data transmission on the internet can have security gaps. Complete protection from third-party access is not possible.

data.name: Privacy_Section3_WithdrawalText
data.value: Consents can be revoked at any time by e-mail. The legality of processing carried out before the revocation remains unaffected.

data.name: Privacy_Section3_ObjectionText
data.value: You have the right to object to processing based on Article 6(1)(e) or (f) GDPR for reasons arising from your particular situation.

data.name: Privacy_Section3_ComplaintText
data.value: If there are infringements of the GDPR, you have the right to complain to the competent supervisory authority.

data.name: Privacy_Section3_PortabilityText
data.value: You have the right to receive data in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format and to transfer it to another controller where technically feasible.

data.name: Privacy_Section3_EncryptionText
data.value: This site uses SSL/TLS for secure transmission of confidential content, recognizable by "https://" and the padlock symbol.

data.name: Privacy_Section3_AccessText
data.value: You can request access to your stored data and request correction or deletion.

data.name: Privacy_Section3_RestrictionText
data.value: You can request restriction where processing validity is in question or the data is no longer needed.

data.name: Privacy_Section4_CookiesText1
data.value: Cookies are small text files stored on your device. They make the site more user-friendly, effective, and secure.

data.name: Privacy_Section4_CookiesText2
data.value: Session cookies are deleted after the visit. Other cookies remain until deletion.

data.name: Privacy_Section4_CookiesText3
data.value: You can configure your browser to inform you about cookies or block them.

data.name: Privacy_Section4_LogsText1
data.value: Automatically collected data includes browser type, OS, referrer, timestamp, and IP address. No merging with other data sources occurs.

data.name: Privacy_Section4_LogsText2
data.value: Collection is based on legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

data.name: Privacy_Section4_ContactText
data.value: When you contact us by email or phone, your data is stored for query processing.

data.name: Privacy_Section4_NewsletterText
data.value: Newsletter data is processed using double opt-in. Consent can be revoked at any time.

data.name: Privacy_Section5_GoogleFontsText
data.value: We use Google Web Fonts. Your IP address may be transmitted to Google.

data.name: Privacy_Section5_GoogleMapsText
data.value: When using Google Maps, your IP address is transmitted to Google.

data.name: Privacy_Section5_GoogleAnalyticsText
data.value: Google Analytics analyzes anonymous user behavior, and IP anonymization is enabled.

data.name: Privacy_Section5_FacebookPixelText
data.value: Facebook Pixel measures conversions; data may be transferred to third countries.

data.name: Privacy_Section5_ReCaptchaText
data.value: reCAPTCHA protects against bots by analyzing user behavior.

data.name: Privacy_Section5_AnalyticsText
data.value: We also use data for AI analysis in anonymized form and with consent.
